I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store is Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own June 9 post in #central-team. The morning receiver there said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login.

I didn't find an address or site ID for Pine Crossing in that channel. The shared files folder for accounts came back empty, so I told her there's nothing more detailed I can see. I only read #central-team, which she's a member of, and didn't use message search.
